bibl.title: New Poetic Fragments from a Neglected Witness of Ps.-Trypho's De tropis: Callimachus, Ps.-Hesiod, Ps.-Simonides.
bibl.seg: Filippomaria Pontani & Maria Giovanna Sandri, New Poetic Fragments from a Neglected Witness of Ps.-Trypho's De tropis: Callimachus, Ps.-Hesiod, Ps.-Simonides.
bibl.note: 0. Introduction. - 1. Allegory in Callimachus' Iambi (5.23-9). - 2. Transposition in "Simonides" (FGE 44 Page = 105 S Sider) [confirms that P. Vindob. Graec. Inv. 29332 (= MP3 457; LDAB 3857) is a witness of Ps.-Trypho's De tropis]. - 3. Mock-modesty in Callimachus' Iambi (4.90-2) [with a correction to P. Oxy. VII, 1011 (= MP3 211.1; LDAB 514) = fr. 194 Pf., l. 90-92]. - 4. Riddle in "Hesiod"'s wedding of Keyx (fr. 266a.8-11 M.-W. = 204A.8-11 Most).
